# Lane `prose-fill-events`: every `event/*` record to completeness 3, ar+en+ur

**Programme.** `docs/delegation/prose-fill-programme.md` (prose-fill, approved 3 Nov 2026). This lane owns **all `data/{event}/*` records** — missing prose and thin (<800 bytes) — raised to `status.completeness: 3` with full sourced Arabic prose and English + Urdu prose in the same commit.

**Queue.** `docs/delegation/prose-queue/event.md`, regenerated by `npx tsx scripts/report/prose-queue.ts` after every large merge. The lane works **bottom-up**: zero-link tail first, ascending by inbound links; the head of each class queue belongs to `prose-backfill-2` (top-down) — the boundary is restated in both progress files at each regeneration. Records logged done in any lane's progress file are never reworked; records in `docs/delegation/showcase-prose-progress.md` are skipped.

**What each record gets.** `content/ar/<class>/<slug>.md` in the class's house structure (`## موجز` first, then the sections the class uses — gold example `content/ar/event/expedition-of-al-sawiq.md` — the event narrated from the chronicle sources, sides on conflicts, dated variants kept as `status: debated`), plus `content/en/` and `content/ur/` in the same commit, all `status.review: published` with `provenance`. Facts cite the sources the record already names, then real book sources from the harvest library (`scripts/harvest/library/books.yaml`, the extracted texts and OCR on the harvest drive; the founder's Mac may download and OCR further PDFs). Chronicle sources on the drive: Tarikh al-Islam, Sallabi's histories, al-Ibar (Ibn Khaldun), Tarikh al-Khulafa, Kamil, Tabari where harvested. A record with no readable source after that pass is logged as a lead with the reason — never padded, never written from Wikipedia/Wikidata alone.

**Batches.** ≤25 records per commit, grouped by source so one book is mined once. Each commit: `npm run cite-check` on the batch ids, `npm run validate` (0 errors), `npm test`, `npm run coverage` in the same commit, explicit paths, attribution trailers, push `content/prose-fill-events`, PR, self-merge.

**Stubs / progress.** `data/_stubs.d/prose-fill-events.yaml` (append-only). Progress `docs/delegation/prose-fill-events-progress.md`: one line per batch — files written, leads, next queue position. Commit prefix `content(prose-fill-events)`.

**Rules.** `AGENTS.md`, `docs/agents/workflow.md`, `docs/agents/content-standards.md`, `docs/agents/mining-sources.md`, `docs/agents/publication-standard.md`. No honorifics typed; no Qur'an text; contested topics use `perspectives` with no verdict.
